Each sub-topic title is a plain line before its picture and 'Kulumbulula' - made a sub-topic heading (h2). Its stray '1.4', trailing full stops, the 'Litiicha' slip and one lower-case start tidied.

_comment_repeats: The manuscript repeats a chapter's title and its opening paragraph word for word in front of three later sub-topics
(Chapter 1 twice, Chapter 3 once: paragraphs 240-241, 443-444, 878-879). Typeset, each read as a new chapter - the three repeats removed.
_comment_breaks: Every sub-topic opens a fresh page; where that left the last 1-4 lines of the previous sub-topic alone on a page, that break is dropped (numbers from _breaks.json).
_comment_afterListGap: Room above a heading that follows a list: 16pt (house 28pt) - with 28pt the last lines of Chapter 5 (and, after the drops, p53) fell alone onto a page.
_comment_labels: Activity labels in one form, Zhakwila N: - the manuscript also has ZHAKWILA 1:, Zhakwila: 3: and Zhakwila: 1 (colon before the number).
